name: labs/drkirkm__syringepump
title: Harvard Apparatus OEM syringe pump
intro: Harvard Apparatus OEM syringe pump, adapted from drkirkm/syringepump. It reads `pumping`; sets `flow_rate` and `diameter`; runs `run_pump` and `stop_all`. `run_pump`: start the configured pump address at the flow rate it was configured with. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/drkirkm__syringepump --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/drkirkm__syringepump --backend fake --mcp
